project.title: Shotgun metagenomics of microbial communities in an urban river receiving reclaimed water in Ningbo, China
project.description: This project investigates microbial community composition, functional potential, and antibiotic resistance gene profiles associated with reclaimed-water replenishment of an urban river in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China. River water samples were collected from three representative locations: a source-proximal river site near the reclaimed-water outlet of the Fuming Purification Plant (1-2), a site approximately 3 km downstream (2-2), and a nearby non-replenished river serving as a local background reference (3-2). Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed to characterize microbial taxonomic composition, reconstruct metagenome-assembled genomes, and examine metabolic functions and antibiotic resistance genes. The sequencing data support spatial comparisons of microbial communities and their encoded functional potential across the source-proximal, downstream, and background locations. This dataset forms part of a broader study integrating water-quality monitoring and dissolved organic matter characterization to assess the environmental implications of reclaimed-water use in urban rivers.
